body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself. Until the start of your next turn, gain +1 Defense against Actions originating more than 2 units away.

surges.html: Until your next turn, you may pass through spaces one size category smaller than normal.
Until the end of this turn, you may climb or leap through difficult terrain without additional movement cost.

rider.title: MIMIC ADAPTATION
rider.html: Before resolving this Action, you may assume Veiled Form. While maintained: Gain +1 Defense against ranged Actions while adjacent to cover or terrain.
